verses.text: And they who were journeying with him saw indeed the light, and were afraid; but they heard not the voice of him who spake to him.

title: JST, Acts 9:7. Compare Acts 9:7 ; 22:9 Those who are with Paul at his conversion see the light, but they do not hear the voice or see the Lord.
